intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Someone has left a blank playbill lying around. Tavri picks it up like it might bite.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “No title. No cast list. Not even a warning about the interval.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Act one, a princess says something clever. Act two, something cleverer. Act three—”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Act three, two people sit somewhere, and nobody leaves at the interval.”

options.labelText: “Call it *A Day with No Auditions.* Short run. Very exclusive.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Dreadful title. Nobody will buy a ticket.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She writes it across the top anyway, in her best handwriting.

options.labelText: “Put your best lines in. Everyone loves a greatest hits.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Greatest hits. Naturally. Track one: the napkin.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She fills it in under a minute. Every line is a good one. Act three doesn’t make the cut.

options.labelText: “You’re only worth the time when you’re being funny.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Then I’ll save you the dull part.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She leaves the playbill blank and goes.
